title: Installments With Guest Mode Off
h1: spi-high-aov control: ordinary Shop Pay sign-up (email, phone, SMS code), then Installments
subtitle: Frames from the Playwright trace of the control spec, run from Erin's machine against production. Same store and product as spec 5, but the guest mode experiment is forced to control, so the buyer signs up with email, phone and SMS code before landing in Pay checkout. Exists to show whether the Installments agreement failure on spi-high-aov depends on guest mode.
store: spi-high-aov.myshopify.com · shop 59271905336 · product-with-unit-price USD 350 (variant 55322433454221) unless SPI_HIGH_AOV_VARIANT is set

moments.name: signed-up
moments.title: C1. Signed up with email, phone and SMS code
moments.body: Benchmark alias {email}: email, phone and the simulated SMS code were all asked for before Pay checkout, as guest mode off requires.

moments.name: installments-selected
moments.title: C2. Address, Pay in installments, card
moments.body: US shipping address filled, Pay in installments selected and a test card added.

moments.name: payment-plans
moments.title: C3. Continue to payment plans
moments.body: The phone was verified at sign-up, so underwriting normally goes straight to Affirm without a second SMS code; the spec enters one only if asked.

moments.name: affirm-identity-done
moments.title: C4. Affirm identity verification
moments.body: Identity verification inside the Affirm iframe completed; the next screen decides the run.

moments.name: installments-unavailable
moments.title: C4. Agreement fails: "We're experiencing technical issues"
moments.body: Shown only when POST /pay/transactions/<token>/agreements fails; the spec fails by name with the recorded status and body.

moments.name: order-confirmed
moments.title: C5. Order confirmed
moments.body: Shown only when the agreement succeeds and the order completes, confirmation {order}.

moments.name: run-end
moments.title: End of run
moments.body: Last screencast frame, {duration} s after the first.

proves: Whether an ordinary (non guest mode) buyer can complete an Installments agreement on spi-high-aov with the same product, identity and browser as spec 5.
caveats: Benchmark identity: simulated SMS code; one run, one browser. Full run {duration} s.
On 2026-09-30 this control failed with the same 422 checkout_error as spec 5, so the failure follows the store rather than guest mode.
